answer: Sponsors are capped at 7 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 36 POA until the newcomer survives 13 clean epochs, and a farm of 460 fakes must find 460 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. What carries the terrace here is verification, the knoll of cost is what stops the farm, and the horizon of the record keeps every claim checkable.
